name: Daisy Related Posts — Display Related Articles, Related Contents, Recommended Posts
author: DaisyPlugins

sections.description:
Daisy Related Posts is a powerful yet lightweight plugin that displays relevant content to your readers after each post. With its eye-catching design and extensive customization options, you can create a perfect related posts section that matches your site’s style.

Key Features:

  • 🎨 Beautiful Design – Attractive, modern layout with smooth hover effects
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Looks great on all devices from mobile to desktop
  • ⚙️ Extensive Customization – Control colors, typography, layout, and more
  • 🔍 Smart Recommendations – Shows truly related content based on categories and tags
  • 🛠️ Easy Configuration – Intuitive settings panel with live previews
  • 🚀 Lightweight – Doesn’t slow down your site

Customization Options Include:

  • Enable/disable related posts
  • Custom section title
  • Number of posts to display
  • Show/hide thumbnails
  • Show/hide excerpts
  • Show/hide author information
  • Show/hide post dates
  • Posts per row for different screen sizes
  • Background color
  • Title color
  • Text color
  • Link color
  • Border radius
  • Box shadow
  • Title font size and weight
  • Text font size

Roadmap

Some planned features for future versions:

  • Shortcode support for manual placement
  • Widget for sidebar display
  • Advanced relatedness algorithm options
  • Animation effects customization
  • Custom post type support configuration

Support

For support, please use the WordPress support forums or visit the plugin’s website.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please fork the GitHub repository and submit pull requests.

Credits

Developed with ❤ by DaisyPlugins.

Special thanks to the WordPress community for inspiration and support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the daisy-related-posts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the settings under ‘Daisy Related Posts’ in the admin menu
  4. Related posts will automatically appear after your single post content
sections.faq:
How do I change the appearance of the related posts section?

Navigate to Settings > Daisy Related Posts in your WordPress admin panel. You’ll find all customization options organized in logical sections.

Can I show related posts on custom post types?

Yes! The plugin automatically works with any post type that supports categories and tags.

What happens if there aren’t enough related posts?

The plugin will automatically fall back to showing recent posts from your site to ensure the section is always populated.

Can I change the number of posts shown on different devices?

Yes! The plugin allows you to set different posts per row for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does this plugin affect my site’s performance?

Daisy Related Posts is optimized for performance with minimal database queries and efficient code.
